notes: Otto's own Meta launch, October 2026: the machine-readable campaign spec that build.py turns into the Ads Manager bulk-import files. Human-readable version: README.md. Source of the rules: docs/GO-TO-MARKET-NL-IE.md §2 (budget, pacing, scaling), §3 (structure, audiences, exclusions), §5 (funnel, KPIs). Nothing here has been created in any Meta account.

pacing.rule: €50/day per market on Advantage+ campaign budget, €4/day minimum per ad set so each of the six concepts gets a fair read. No edits for 72 hours after launch except disapprovals and broken tracking.
Remove the ad-set minimums; let the campaign budget move to the winners.
The scaling rules apply (per market, judged on the last 7 days).

scaling.signal: An ad: ≥ €10 spent and link CTR < 0.5 %, or ≥ €15 spent and 0 scans
scaling.action: Pause it; replace it in the Monday refresh

scaling.signal: An ad set (concept): ≥ €50 spent and cost per scan result > €16 (2× target)
scaling.action: Pause it; its budget flows to the others; bring a new concept from the bank next Monday

scaling.signal: Market: cost per paying customer ≤ €150 with ≥ 3 purchases (or ≤ €30 per trial start before purchases exist)
scaling.action: +20 % budget every 72 h, up to €150/day by day 30

scaling.signal: Market: > €300 per paying customer for 7 days, or €600 spent with 0 purchases
scaling.action: −30 % budget; review landing, offer and sign-up flow before spending more

scaling.signal: One market's cost per paying customer (or per trial start) < 70 % of the other's
scaling.action: Move €10/day to it (floor €30/day per market so the other keeps learning)

audience.languages: none (many Dutch owners run their phone in English)

nl.a6: Restaurants, Coffeehouses, Hospitality industry, Small business owners
